claim: On October 8, 2024 ElastiCache added support for Valkey. Valkey 7.2.6 is compatible with Redis OSS 7.2.
question: When did ElastiCache add the Valkey engine, and which Redis OSS version was Valkey 7.2.6 compatible with?

values.display: Valkey 7.2.6 is compatible with Redis OSS 7.2
values.spoken: Valkey seven point two point six is compatible with Redis OSS seven point two

note: The date when 'Redis' became 'Redis OSS' in the product name is not stated on any saved page (not found).
